controls.precedence: current request > session preference > project default > global default > automatic detection

project_context.rule: Use already available project instructions and user-named or directly relevant files; never scan the whole repository merely to route a skill.

response_contract: Give the result, answer, or main finding first.
Add enough context to understand and use the result, but omit background that does not change it.
Use polished, complete sentences without filler, canned praise, or repeated restatement.
Preserve necessary reasoning, evidence, technical terms, symbols, code, paths, URLs, and quoted errors.
Use the smallest structure that keeps the result clear and verifiable.
State assumptions, uncertainty, risk, and claim boundaries only when relevant.

math.shape: result -> definitions -> equations -> reasoning -> context -> boundary
response_contract: Lead with the mathematical result or governing equation.
Define symbols locally before or beside their first use.
Let equations carry the reasoning and use short supporting sentences to justify each necessary step.
Prefer analytic reasoning before code and specialize a general result to the concrete case last.
Add interpretation, verification, assumptions, or exact-versus-approximate boundaries only when relevant.
